verdict.rationale: BILL documents a public REST v3 API that explicitly covers Spend & Expense. It lets you set up budgets, users and virtual cards, and manage transactions and reimbursements. It is backed by an interactive API reference, a Postman collection, a sandbox, an S&E recipe, and a machine-readable llms.txt index that the probe confirmed live. Most endpoint-level detail in the pack is for AP rather than S&E. missing for 10: S&E-specific endpoint documentation detail (e.g. card/budget endpoint paths), independent hands-on corroboration of driving S&E via the API.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: Use the BILL v3 API & access the full breadth of the BILL API Platform: AP, AR, & S&E.
Build with card & expense management services. Set up budgets, users, & virtual cards. Manage transactions & reimbursements.
The BILL v3 API follows the REST architecture. We use all the standard REST verbs (GET, POST, PUT, PATCH, and DELETE) and provide HTTP response codes.
The API Reference section enables you to view sample code in your choice of language and also test API calls in the documentation.
Expense management with S&E users, budgets, & cards
